name: get_document_info
description: Photoshop version, open documents, and the active (or named) document's size, mode and full layer tree (id, path, kind, visibility, opacity, blend mode, bounds, text).

document.description: Document name. Omit for the active document.

layers.description: Include the layer tree. Default true.

name: create_document
description: Create a new RGB document. Common sizes: 1080x1080 (IG square), 1080x1350 (IG portrait), 1080x1920 (story/reel), 1920x1080.

name: open_file
description: Open an image or PSD from disk.

name: add_layer
description: Add a layer: pixel (empty), text, group, solid (fills the canvas or rect), rectangle or ellipse (filled shape, rasterized). Fonts use PostScript names, e.g. "ArialMT", "Montserrat-Bold".

box.description: [x, y, width, height]: makes paragraph (wrapping) text.

color.description: "#rrggbb". Text or fill color. Default black.

blendMode.description: normal, multiply, screen, overlay, softlight, hardlight, colordodge, lineardodge, color, luminosity, ...

name: set_layer_properties
description: Change a layer's name, visibility, opacity, fill opacity, blend mode, lock, and (text layers) text, font, size, color, justification, tracking, leading.

layer.description: Layer id (number), "Group/Layer" path, or name. Omit for the active layer.

name: transform_layer
description: Move, scale, rotate, flip, center or fit a layer. Order: fit, scale, rotate, flip, moveBy, x/y, center.

fit.description: Scale to fit inside / fill the canvas, centered.

anchor.description: For scale/rotate: topleft, topcenter, middlecenter (default), bottomright, ...

x.description: Move the layer's left edge (or center, with align=center) here.

align.description: What x/y refer to. Default topleft.

name: layer_action
description: delete, duplicate, select, bring_forward, send_backward, to_top, to_bottom, move_into (a group), merge_down, rasterize, unlock_background, mask_from_selection, remove_background (Select Subject + mask), convert_to_smart_object.

name: place_image
description: Place an image file as a smart-object layer in the document, centered by default.

fit.description: Scale to fit inside / fill the canvas.

width.description: Scale to this width in px (keeps aspect).

x.description: Left edge. Omit x and y to center.

name: apply_filter
description: Apply a filter or adjustment to a pixel layer. Filters and params: gaussian_blur {radius}, motion_blur {angle, radius}, radial_blur {amount}, add_noise {amount, monochromatic}, median {radius}, unsharp_mask {amount, radius, threshold}, sharpen, high_pass {radius}, brightness_contrast {brightness, contrast}, levels {inputBlack, inputWhite, gamma, outputBlack, outputWhite}, hue_saturation {hue, saturation, lightness}, colorize {hue, saturation, lightness}, photo_filter {color, density}, desaturate, invert, auto_levels, auto_contrast, posterize {levels}, threshold {level}. Rasterize smart objects/text first.

name: selection
description: Selections: all, none, invert, rect, ellipse, subject (AI Select Subject on the given/active layer), layer_pixels (select a layer's opaque pixels), fill (fill selection on the active layer), clear, stroke, crop (crop document to selection). Returns the selection bounds.

name: resize_document
description: Resize the image (resample), change the canvas size, or crop to a rectangle.

name: preview_document
description: Render the document (all visible layers) and return it as an image so you can see the result.

name: export_document
description: Save a copy as png, jpg, psd or tif (the open document keeps its own file).

name: save_document
description: Save the document (PSD). Pass path to Save As.

name: close_document
description: Close a document, discarding changes unless save is true.

name: undo
description: Step back (or forward with redo) through the History panel. Each MCP tool call is one history step.

name: run_extendscript
description: Escape hatch: run any Photoshop ExtendScript (ES3) and get the last expression's value back. Helpers available: findDoc, findLayer, toColor, describeDoc, describeLayer, selectRect, px.
